heading: Tonight
text: Periods of clouds, with scattered showers spreading south, isolated in NY. Partial clearing north late. Cooler. Patchy valley fog. Lows in the 40s to low 50s. Winds north near 10 mph, diminishing to light outside the Champlain Valley.

heading: Sunday
text: Patches of fog, with any early showers south ending. Increasing sunshine, mixed with afternoon clouds. Highs in the upper 60s to low 70s north, low to mid 70s in the Champlain Valley and south. Light winds, mainly north up to 10 mph.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Becoming mostly clear. Areas of dense valley fog. Lows in the 40s to low 50s. Winds northwest near 10 mph, diminishing to light outside the Champlain Valley.

heading: Monday, Labor Day
text: Dense valley fog burning off by mid-morning. Mostly sunny. Highs in the 70s. Light winds, becoming northwest near 10 mph.
